analogy.rationale: SLC18A1/SLC18A2 (VMAT1/VMAT2) are expressed mainly in neurons and neuroendocrine cells, which are not represented among these nine cancer cell lines, so VMAT inhibitors should elicit little or no transcriptional response. Other monoaminergic-targeting classes are listed only as the nearest (still weak) mechanistic neighbors.
